component.name: Cadence
component.summary: Fast native music player for Navidrome, OpenSubsonic and Jellyfin

description.p: Cadence is a fast, native music player for your self-hosted library (Navidrome, OpenSubsonic, Jellyfin), with YouTube Music discovery, personal mixes and player-to-player control. It is written in Rust, plays audio through mpv and is a fork of Feishin by jeffvli.

ul.li: Connects to Navidrome, OpenSubsonic, Subsonic and Jellyfin servers
Browses albums, artists, genres, playlists and songs from large libraries
Gapless playback, a play queue that is restored on restart and scrobbling
Synchronized lyrics, media keys and desktop media controls (MPRIS)

description.p: First native build, released as Cadence.
